2521-lizzie-leigh.title: Lizzie Leigh
2521-lizzie-leigh.creator: Elizabeth Gaskell
2521-lizzie-leigh.description: A book by Elizabeth Gaskell. But those last blessed words replaced him on his throne in her heart, and called out penitent anguish for all the bitter estrangement of later years. It was this which made her refuse all the entreaties of her sons, that she would see the kind-hearted neighbours, who called on their way from church, to sympathize and condole.

7816-the-voyage-of-captain-popanilla.title: The Voyage Of Captain Popanilla
7816-the-voyage-of-captain-popanilla.creator: Benjamin Disraeli
7816-the-voyage-of-captain-popanilla.description: A book by Benjamin Disraeli. As the red and rayless sun drops into the glowing waters, the choruses simultaneously join; and rushing from the woods, and down the mountain steeps to the nearest shore, crowds of human beings, at the same moment, appear and collect.

arxiv-2101-08990.title: Self-similar analysis of the time-dependent compressible and incompressible boundary layers including heat conduction
arxiv-2101-08990.creator: Imre Ferenc Barna 1 , Krisztián Hriczó 2 , Gabriella Bognár 2 , and László Mátyás 3
arxiv-2101-08990.description: Abstract We investigate the incompressible and compressible heat conducting boundary layer with applying the two-dimensional self-similar Ansatz. Analytic solutions can be found for the incompressible case which can be expressed with special functions. The parameter dependencies are studied and discussed in details.

arxiv-2103-11406.title: Variations of Ramanujan’s Euler Products
arxiv-2103-11406.creator: Shin-ya Koyama & Nobushige Kurokawa
arxiv-2103-11406.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shin-ya Koyama & Nobushige Kurokawa. We study the meromorphy of various Euler products of degree two attached to holomorphic Hecke eigen cusp forms for the elliptic modular group, including Ramanujan’s Δ \Delta -function. Key Words: Euler products; zeta functions; Ramanujan’s \Delta -function; cusp forms; modular group AMS Subject Classifications: 11M06, 11M41, Introduction In 1916 Ramanujan [ 12 ] studied the Euler product associated to Ramanujan’s \tau -function defined as \Delta(z)=e^{2\pi iz}\prod_{n=1}^{\infty}(1-e^{2\pi inz})^{24}=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\tau(n)e^{2\pi inz} for \Im(z)>0 .

arxiv-2405-04102.title: Analysis of Markovian Arrivals and Service with Applications to Intermittent Overload
arxiv-2405-04102.creator: Isaac Grosof, Yige Hong, Mor Harchol-Balter
arxiv-2405-04102.description: Abstract In many important real-world queueing settings, arrival and service rates fluctuate over time. We consider the MAMS system, where the arrival and service rates each vary according to an arbitrary finite-state Markov chain, allowing intermittent overload to be modeled.

arxiv-2409-00555.title: Direct numerical simulation of two boundary layers with the same pressure distribution but different surface curvatures
arxiv-2409-00555.creator: P. R. Spalart \aff 1 \corresp, K. E. Jansen \aff 2, G. N. Coleman \aff 3
arxiv-2409-00555.description: Abstract A pair of Direct Numerical Simulations is used to investigate curvature and pressure effects. One has a Gaussian test bump and a straight opposite wall, while the other has a straight test wall and a blowing/suction distribution on an opposite porous boundary, adjusted to produce the same pressure distribution.

arxiv-2410-02670.title: Magnetic evolution of active regions: formation and eruption of magnetic flux ropes
arxiv-2410-02670.creator: P. Vemareddy
arxiv-2410-02670.description: Abstract Magnetic flux ropes (FRs) are twisted structures appearing on the sun, predominantly in the magnetically concentrated regions. These structures appear as coronal features known as filaments or prominences in H α \alpha observations, and as sigmoids in X-ray, EUV observations.

arxiv-2510-07364.title: Base Models Know How to Reason, Thinking Models Learn When
arxiv-2510-07364.creator: Constantin VenhoffUniversity of OxfordUnited Kingdom constantin@robots.ox.ac.uk, Iván ArcuschinUniversity of Buenos AiresArgentina iarcuschin@dc.uba.ar Philip TorrUniversity of OxfordUnited KingdomArthur ConmyNeel Nanda
arxiv-2510-07364.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Constantin VenhoffUniversity of OxfordUnited Kingdom constantin@robots.ox.ac.uk, Iván ArcuschinUniversity of Buenos AiresArgentina iarcuschin@dc.uba.ar Philip TorrUniversity of OxfordUnited KingdomArthur ConmyNeel Nanda. Why do thinking language models like DeepSeek R1 outperform their base counterparts? Despite consistent performance gains, it remains unclear to what extent thinking models learn entirely new reasoning capabilities or repurpose pre-existing base model ones.

arxiv-2511-17593.title: Comparative Analysis of Large Language Model Inference Serving Systems: A Performance Study of vLLM and HuggingFace TGI
arxiv-2511-17593.creator: Saicharan Kolluru
arxiv-2511-17593.description: Abstract The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) in production environments requires efficient inference serving systems that balance throughput, latency, and resource utilization. This paper presents a comprehensive empirical evaluation of two prominent open-source LLM serving frameworks: vLLM and HuggingFace Text Generation Inference (TGI).

arxiv-2601-21747.title: Temporal Sepsis Modeling: a Fully Interpretable Relational Way
arxiv-2601-21747.creator: Vincent Lemaire, Nédra Mellouli, Pierre Jaquet
arxiv-2601-21747.description: Abstract Sepsis remains one of the most complex and heterogeneous syndromes in intensive care, characterized by diverse physiological trajectories and variable responses to treatment. While deep learning models perform well in the early prediction of sepsis, they often lack interpretability and ignore latent patient sub-phenotypes.

molitor-de-lamiis-latin-1498.creator: Ulrich Molitor

pmc-10648804.title: Critical Velocity, Maximal Lactate Steady State, and Muscle MCT1 and MCT4 after Exhaustive Running in Mice
pmc-10648804.creator: Juan B Orsi, Lara S Araujo, Pedro P M Scariot, Emanuel E C Polisel, Luisa O Cardoso, Claudio A Gobatto, Fúlvia B Manchado-Gobatto, Anastasios Lymperopoulos
pmc-10648804.description: Although the critical velocity (CV) protocol has been used to determine the aerobic capacity in rodents, there is a lack of studies that compare CV with maximal lactate steady state intensity (iMLSS) in mice. As a consequence, their physiological and molecular responses after exercise until exhaustion at CV intensity remain unclear.

pmc-10766681.title: Effect of Pigmented Rice Consumption on Cardiometabolic Risk Factors: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials
pmc-10766681.creator: Diane Mendoza-Sarmiento, Emmanuele V Mistades, Alison M Hill
pmc-10766681.description: Purpose of ReviewDietary patterns that include polyphenols may help manage cardiometabolic risk factors. Pigmented rice contains phenolic acids and flavonoids that contribute to its antioxidant properties. This review examined the effect of polyphenol-containing pigmented rice on antioxidant status, lipid profile, glucose/insulin, blood pressure, and weight among adults.

pmc-11455647.title: Preterm Neonates Admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit of a Tertiary Care Hospital: A Descriptive Cross-sectional Study
pmc-11455647.creator: Dhirendra Prasad Yadav, Vivek Kumar, Shweta Kumari Shah, Kishor Shah
pmc-11455647.description: Introduction:Prematurity is a significant cause of neonatal morbidity and mortality, especially in low-income and middle-income countries like Nepal. However, there is a paucity of data regarding its burden. This study aimed to determine the prevalence and outcomes of preterm neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit of a tertiary care hospital.

pmc-11469507.title: Differential associations between experiences of contraceptive care and subsequent contraceptive access and preferences among family planning patients by racial and ethnic identity: Evidence from Arizona, Iowa, and Wisconsin
pmc-11469507.creator: Megan L. Kavanaugh, Madeleine Haas, Ayana Douglas-Hall
pmc-11469507.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). While many frameworks exist for building person-centered and equitable systems of contraceptive care, evidence indicates that the reality of patients’ experiences of care is often not in alignment with these ideals. Historical and current contexts of racism in the healthcare system contribute to negative perceptions and experiences of care, as well as reduced care-seeking behavior, for those who identify as Black, Indigenous, and people of color (BIPOC).

pmc-11599943.title: Stitched textile-based microfluidics for wearable devices†
pmc-11599943.creator: Martin Hanze, Andrew Piper, Mahiar Max Hamedi
pmc-11599943.description: Thread-based microfluidics, which rely on capillary forces in threads for liquid flow, are a promising alternative to conventional microfluidics, as they can be easily integrated into wearable textile-based biosensors. We present here advanced textile-based microfluidic devices fabricated by machine stitching, using only commercially available textiles.

pmc-11713864.title: Patterns in NIA Health Disparities Research Framework Domains and AD‐Plasma Biomarkers
pmc-11713864.creator: Maria Vassilaki, Jeremiah A Aakre, Anna M Castillo, Timothy G Lesnick, Walter K Kremers, Alicia Algeciras‐Schimnich, Jonathan Graff‐Radford, David S Knopman, Thomas H Mosley, B Gwen Windham, Michael E Griswold, Val J Lowe, Clifford R Jack, Ronald C Petersen, Prashanthi Vemuri
pmc-11713864.description: BackgroundThe NIA Health Disparities Research (NIA‐HD) Framework organizes factors in four domains (i.e., environmental, sociocultural, behavioral, and biological), which work together over the lifetime to influence health and health disparities.MethodIn previous work, we employed a 2‐stage approach using factor and principal component (PC) analyses to identify patterns of factors in the domains of the NIA‐HD Framework.

pmc-12558518.title: MONTUR project: Dataset for understanding and forecasting tourist flows
pmc-12558518.creator: Marco Alderighi, Tiziana Ciano, Massimiliano Ferrara, Domenico Santoro
pmc-12558518.description: This study presents an advanced system for monitoring and forecasting tourist flows in the Aosta Valley using distributed sensor technologies, cameras, and machine learning algorithms. This innovative system is designed to provide real-time data on arrivals and presences throughout the region, helping to manage traffic and tourism resources more effectively.

pmc-13340682.title: Congenital non-parasitic hepatic cyst complicated by hepatoduodenal fistula: a rare case report
pmc-13340682.creator: Ammar Mouhammad, Rahaf Massoud, Ahmad Maken Al Mamoun, Leen Salloum, Luna Abou Tok, Rafat Horoub
pmc-13340682.description: Introduction and importance:Simple hepatic cysts are benign and usually asymptomatic; however, they can rarely develop serious complications, such as hepatoduodenal fistula, due to infection, cyst size, or mechanical pressure.Case presentation:A 68-year-old male presented with fever, hematochezia, and severe right upper quadrant pain.
